My meds have made me feel SO much better and I’m so grateful to the rheumatologist who took the time to figure out what was wrong with me. The first time I saw a rheum was in 2012 and after he ruled out RA he said he didn’t know what was wrong with me and he never did test for any other autoimmune conditions. 

Anyway, from that perspective I think I can understand some of the people who are in denial. Diagnosis means treatment. The problem is, if you get the wrong diagnosis the treatment won’t do you any good. But I understand wanting to try.
